description: EgoLife segmentation-only PUBLIC manifest. Contains per-session timing + wall-clock metadata, DenseCaption-source identifiers (participant, day, session_idx, clip_offsets), summary-tile coordinates (`passes.1.summaries[{start, end}]`), and the OLMo-derived coalesced segmentation (`passes.1.actions[{start, end, event}]`). EgoLife DenseCaption text, our NLLB translations, and OLMo `facts` are NOT included; rehydrate them from your own EgoLife download + translator + Stage-4 OLMo run via `python scripts/data/egolife/build_manifest.py --public-manifest <path>` + `annotate_manifest.py`.
